subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 8 5 1 7 3 5 2 8 7 6 9 8 (Right)

How many such odd numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 8 5 1 7 3 5 2 8 7 6 9 8 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Odd — Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1e0fc0f109f7c22ea0c1699e4bc6b3a323d811fa0e514550e34a7f80d2c096f.png] 

Thus, there is one odd number, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
